name: Corfu, Greece

visa.notes: Financially independent person visa requires ~€2,000/mo income proof.

rent.notes: Spitogatos Q2 2026 asking rent in Corfu about 13.4 EUR/sqm for small units (most expensive student market in Greece); long-term listings seen: 2BR 100 sqm house near Kato Garouna 750 EUR bills included, 1BR Corfu town 640-900 EUR; Expatistan 85 sqm furnished about 519 EUR (few data points). Pet-friendly 2-3BR year-round lets are scarce and priced at the upper end.

sources.title: Athens Times: Student rental prices surge, Corfu most expensive (Spitogatos Q2 2026)
Rentyournest: apartment Ethniki Odos Lefkimis, Corfu
Expatistan: rent 85m2 normal area Corfu

groceries.notes: Two adults at about 230-250 EUR each (Expat Exchange Corfu 200-300 EUR per person; Greek basket is Europe's cheapest per IELKA) plus 100+ EUR/month of food for a large-breed dog. Island supermarket prices run a little above Athens but local produce is cheap; food CPI +0.9% y/y Aug 2026.

sources.title: Expat Exchange: Cost of living in Corfu
Athens Times: How Much Does a Dog Really Cost in Greece in 2026

utilities.notes: Electricity (AC in summer, heat pump/oil in the wet Corfu winter) plus municipal water: Expat Exchange 100-150 EUR for one person, Jobicy 100-150 USD; island water 100-300 EUR/yr. Uplifted for the November 2026 tariff rises (PPC green 0.169 EUR/kWh, other suppliers +30-76%).

sources.title: Expat Exchange: Cost of living in Corfu

healthcare.notes: National private-cover pricing: basic plans 50-100 EUR and mid-range 125-250 EUR per person per month (Feather, Apr 2026); 80-150 EUR per person by age (Crete Direct, Jun 2026). Two 60-year-olds on basic-to-mid plans about 260 EUR. Corfu has a public hospital but limited private capacity, so expats often travel to Athens for specialist care.

insurance.notes: Re-modelled from old template (health) to renters/contents cover. COSMOTE Insurance/Hellas Direct contents-only policies for tenants cost 18-54 EUR per year for 6,000-25,000 EUR of cover; sold nationally online.

transportation.notes: A car is needed outside Corfu town: fuel 1.85-2.00 EUR/L for about 800 km/month, basic third-party insurance about 150-200 EUR/yr (national online quote, driver 36-65), road tax unchanged for 2026, maintenance; KTEL island buses are infrequent (Expat Exchange 30-50 EUR/month pass). Transport CPI +11.3% y/y Sept 2026.

entertainment.notes: Fibre/VDSL internet 25-40 EUR (Cosmote/Nova; fibre coverage patchy outside Corfu town), streaming about 30 EUR, taverna dinner for two 35-55 EUR a few times a month, plus activities.

healthcare.system: Corfu General Hospital for basic care. Specialist treatment may require travel to Athens or Thessaloniki.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 4-12 weeks. Complex cases need mainland referral.

pros: Lush green Ionian island (unlike drier Aegean islands)

pros.text: Venetian, French, and British architectural heritage (Old Town of Corfu UNESCO World Heritage, listed 2007)
